listen_addr.description: IP address or hostname to bind the gfsd service to. Use '*' to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port for the gfsd daemon to accept client connections.

spool_dir.description: Directory where gfsd stores runtime state, including PID and lock files.

metadata_cache_dir.description: Directory for caching file metadata (e.g., directory listings) to improve performance.

max_worker_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads handling client I/O requests.

max_client_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections the daemon accepts.

client_keepalive_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for idle client connections before termination.

use_kerberos.description: Enable Kerberos v5 authentication for client access.

items.description: GFM (Gfarm metadata server) host, optionally with port (e.g., 'gfm.example.com:15005').

gfm_host_list.description: List of metadata servers (GFM) for the gfsd to connect to. At least one is required.

enable_io_checksum.description: Enable verification of end-to-end data integrity using checksums during I/O.

log_level.description: Minimum log level (DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR) to record in the log.

rlimit_nofile.description: Soft limit on open file descriptors for the gfsd process.

sync_metadata.description: Force synchronous updates to metadata (slower but safer in case of failure).

replication_factor.description: Default number of copies (replicas) for newly created files.

replication_constraint.description: Placement constraint for replicas (e.g., 'rack:1' ensures replicas are on different racks).

enable_quota.description: Enable enforcement of per-user or per-project quotas.

items.description: Trusted IP network range in CIDR notation allowed to perform admin operations.

admin_trusted_cidrs.description: List of trusted networks for administrative access.

verbose_io_log.description: Log detailed I/O operations (e.g., read/write per-file stats) for debugging.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate (PEM format) for TLS client connections.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the server private key (PEM format, unencrypted) for TLS.

use_ssl.description: Enable TLS encryption for client–server communication.

ssl_ca_cert_file.description: CA certificate bundle for verifying the GFM server’s TLS certificate.

ssl_verify_hostname.description: Verify that the GFM server’s certificate matches its hostname during TLS handshake.

use_gsi.description: Enable GSI (Grid Security Infrastructure) authentication instead of Kerberos.

gsi_proxy_cert.description: Path to the GSI proxy certificate (used only if use_gsi is true).

use_dns.description: Perform DNS reverse-lookup on client IP to resolve hostname (used for logging and auth).

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for network binding and connections.

chroot_dir.description: Path to chroot directory (leave empty to disable chrooting for security).

access_log_to_syslog.description: Send file access logs to syslog (useful for centralized log aggregation).

access_log_file.description: Path to file for access logs if not using syslog. Set to empty to disable file logging.
